items.title: The creek in fall
items.copy: Five Mile Creek runs slow enough here to hold the whole bank upside down.
items.alt: Still water on Five Mile Creek reflecting gold and green fall leaves, with branches hanging over from both banks and a log at the waterline.

items.title: Fog on the low ground
items.copy: It settles in the open field overnight and stays until the sun clears the trees.
items.alt: Low fog across an open field at dawn, two large trees on the right, a treeline behind them, and the sky going from orange to blue.

items.title: Turkeys in the cemetery
items.copy: Three of them working the wet grass past the old stones.
items.alt: Three wild turkeys walking across wet grass in a cemetery, with weathered headstones in the foreground and heavy green woods behind.

items.title: Common buckeye
items.copy: The eyespots are the tell. They turn up in any weedy patch that gets sun.
items.alt: A common buckeye butterfly with brown and orange eyespots on its wings, resting on grass seed heads in a green field.
